messages.text:
What it is: Telegram reply egress is at-least-once — a dropped SSE socket must not silently eat a reply
What it solves: RELATED: BL-274 (front-desk bot epic), BL-292 (headless front-desk launcher),
BL-302 (Telegram bot poll crash resilience).
How it works: Dropped SSE socket triggers reconnect and replay of unacked entries
